title: Bawah Sepuluh
subject: a seventeen-year-old at a WCA Rubik's cube competition in a Subang Jaya school hall chasing his first sub-ten-second average of five, one solve lost when the cube pops a piece under a chair, the boy beside him explaining that the best and worst times get dropped
caption: Math rock with midwest-emo vocals, sung in Malay, in the twinkly Southeast Asian math rock style. Two clean electric guitars playing interlocking two-hand tapped arpeggios in 7/8 and 5/4 that snap back to 4/4 for the choruses; a melodic electric bass playing busy counter-lines high on the neck; live drums with tight stop-start fills, ride-bell accents and sudden full-band hits. Bright, dry live-room mix, guitars clean and sparkling, drums punchy. Male tenor vocal, earnest and slightly strained, talk-singing the verses and pushing into a cracked shout in the choruses, with gang vocals shouting along on the last chorus. 144 BPM, E major. Nervous, giddy and triumphant. No distortion wall, no metal breakdown, no pop-punk power chords, no synth, no autotune, no programmed drums.
lyrics:
[Intro - twinkly tapped guitars in 7/8, drums crash in]

[Verse 1]
Dewan sekolah Subang, Sabtu pukul sembilan
Seratus budak, semua pegang kiub
Aku nombor empat puluh satu, tapak tangan berpeluh
Hakim tutup kiub aku bawah kotak

[Pre-Chorus]
"Sedia?" Aku angguk
Jantung aku lari, tak ikut tempo

[Chorus]
Lima belas saat tengok, lepas tu jangan fikir
Jari ikut je apa yang dah hafal
"Lapan saat!" "Dua belas!" hakim jerit
Tepuk pad, tengok nombor, satu lagi

[Verse 2]
Satu, sepuluh poin lima
Dua, kiub terburai, sekeping lari bawah kerusi
Tiga, lapan poin sembilan satu, budak sebelah bersiul
"Bang, buang paling laju, buang paling teruk"

[Chorus]
Lima belas saat tengok, lepas tu jangan fikir
Jari ikut je apa yang dah hafal
Dua lagi, dua je lagi, purata bawah sepuluh
Tepuk pad, jangan tengok, satu lagi

[Bridge - guitars drop to one tapped line, then the band builds]
Empat, sembilan poin enam
Lima, aku tutup mata masa tepuk pad

[Chorus - full band, gang vocals shouting along]
Lima belas saat tengok, lepas tu jangan fikir
Jari aku lagi laju dari jantung aku
Purata sembilan poin sembilan lapan
Satu dewan tepuk tangan, jari aku masih menggigil

[Outro - tapped guitars ringing out, one last band hit]
